# Sina's Creations

> One-of-one fused-glass jewelry and art, handmade by Thomasina Schnepf in Queen Creek, Arizona. Every piece is unique, named, and sold once -- when it's adopted, it's gone for good.

Sina's Creations sells handcrafted fused-glass pendants, necklaces, earrings, bracelets, charms, ornaments, and wall plaques. Each product is a single physical piece, not a reproducible SKU -- once purchased ("adopted"), that exact piece is retired from sale while its permanent product page remains as part of Thomasina's body of work.

## Key pages

- [Shop](https://www.sinascreations.com/shop): full current catalog and collection browsing
- [Meet Sina](https://www.sinascreations.com/meet-sina): the artist's story
- [Commission](https://www.sinascreations.com/commission): custom/commissioned piece requests
- [Wholesale](https://www.sinascreations.com/wholesale): wholesale partnership inquiries
- [Sitemap](https://www.sinascreations.com/sitemap.xml): machine-readable list of canonical public pages

## Product pages

- Every published creation has one permanent canonical URL: `https://www.sinascreations.com/p/<SKU>`.
- Product pages contain the creation's name, description/story, image, SKU, category, price, availability, and Product structured data.
- The permanent page remains useful after adoption and reports the piece as sold rather than disappearing.
- Product availability changes frequently; always prefer the live product page over cached summaries.
- The Adopt action verifies live Shopify inventory at click time before starting checkout.
